Jharkhand students' protest leads to cancellation of JSSC exams

Students protesting exam irregularities in Jharkhand have had their demands met, leading to the cancellation of the JSSC-CGL exam and all other exams conducted by the firm TDPL. The Jharkhand government accepted the students' demands, prompting emotional reactions from aspirants. The protests, which involved students facing difficult conditions like rain and illness, had been ongoing. Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi urged Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren to personally intervene and meet with the job aspirants.
